normalization.overview: An EGM walkthrough tests whether fresh-context review adds consequential findings or repeats the same missing assumptions.
normalization.whyItMatters: Fresh context can expose an incomplete specification while retaining correlated errors and omitted business constraints.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Adapt author/reviewer separation and measure valid additional findings together with adjudication cost before expanding the process.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the narrow adaptation if a bounded comparison exposes consequential omissions missed by the existing review at a defensible full cost; narrow use if findings mostly repeat, fail adjudication or require avoidable resolution work.
